title: S3 bucket has public read access enabled
description: The S3 bucket 'customer-backups-prod' has public read access enabled via bucket ACL. Any internet user can read the contents of this bucket.
ai_context: This bucket contains production customer backup data in a HIPAA-tagged account. Public read access was enabled 6 hours ago, likely through an accidental ACL modification during a deployment. Three distinct external IP addresses have accessed the bucket since the configuration change. This represents a potential customer data exposure and HIPAA breach notification obligation. Immediate remediation is required.
ai_remediation_steps: Apply S3 Block Public Access at the bucket level
Remove any public-read ACL grants
Review and restrict bucket policy
Enable S3 access logging if not already enabled
Download and analyze access logs for the 3 accessing IPs
Assess breach notification obligations under HIPAA

title: Security group allows unrestricted SSH access (0.0.0.0/0)
description: Security group 'web-server-security-group-prod' has an inbound rule allowing SSH (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0. This exposes the SSH service to the entire internet.
ai_context: This security group is attached to 8 production web server instances. Unrestricted SSH access exposes these servers to brute-force attacks and exploitation of SSH vulnerabilities. CloudTrail shows no legitimate SSH connections from non-corporate IPs in the last 90 days, suggesting this rule was added inadvertently. Recommend restricting to VPN CIDR range only.
ai_remediation_steps: Identify the VPN or bastion host IP range used for administrative access
Update the security group rule to restrict SSH to that specific CIDR range
Remove the 0.0.0.0/0 inbound rule for port 22
Verify no active SSH sessions will be disrupted
Consider using AWS Systems Manager Session Manager as a zero-trust SSH alternative

title: IAM role has wildcard resource permissions in production account
description: IAM role 'dev-admin-role' has an attached policy with 'Resource: *' on EC2 and S3 write actions in the production account.
ai_context: This IAM role grants overly broad permissions including the ability to write to any S3 bucket and terminate any EC2 instance in the production account. The role is named 'dev-admin' but is deployed in the production account (meridian-production). This violates least-privilege principles and creates significant blast radius risk if credentials are compromised. Three IAM users can assume this role.
ai_remediation_steps: Audit the three users who can assume this role and verify their need for production access
Create a scoped replacement policy with only the specific S3 buckets and EC2 instances required
Update the role to use the scoped policy
Remove the wildcard resource policy
Consider adding IAM condition keys to further restrict access by source IP or MFA status
Review CloudTrail for any suspicious use of this role in the last 90 days

title: RDS instance does not have encryption at rest enabled
description: RDS instance 'analytics-db-dev' in the development account does not have encryption at rest enabled.
ai_context: This RDS instance is in the development account and does not contain production customer data (confirmed by data classification tags). Encryption-at-rest is disabled because the instance was created from a legacy snapshot that predates the encryption policy. The team has a migration to a new encrypted instance planned for the next sprint. A 30-day exception has been requested.
ai_remediation_steps: Create an encrypted snapshot of the current database
Restore the snapshot to a new encrypted RDS instance
Verify data integrity on the new instance
Update connection strings for all services connecting to this database
Decommission the unencrypted instance
exception_justification: Migration to encrypted instance in progress. Estimated completion: June 25, 2026. No customer data in this database.

title: CloudTrail log file validation is not enabled
description: The CloudTrail trail 'data-platform-trail' does not have log file validation enabled. This means log integrity cannot be verified.
ai_context: CloudTrail log file validation creates a hash-based chain of digest files that can be used to verify that log files have not been modified or deleted since CloudTrail wrote them. Without validation, audit logs cannot be certified as tamper-free — a requirement for SOC 2 CC7 and HIPAA audit trail controls. This is a medium finding but has compliance implications. Remediation is a one-click change with no operational impact.
ai_remediation_steps: Enable log file validation on the CloudTrail trail via the AWS console or CLI
Verify validation is active by checking the trail's EnableLogFileValidation property
This change has no operational impact and does not require a change window

title: Azure Storage account does not enforce HTTPS-only access
description: Azure Storage account 'meridianprodstorage001' does not have the 'Secure transfer required' setting enabled. HTTP access is permitted.
ai_context: This storage account was configured to allow both HTTP and HTTPS access. While no HTTP access has been observed in access logs, the configuration creates a potential for data transmission without encryption in transit. This finding has been remediated.

title: EC2 instance has public IP and exposes administrative ports
description: Sandbox EC2 instance 'sandbox-test-server-01' has a public IP address and a security group allowing RDP (port 3389) from 0.0.0.0/0.
ai_context: This Windows sandbox instance is directly accessible from the internet via RDP. While in a sandbox account (no customer data), it poses a risk of being used as a pivot point for further attacks. Sandbox environments should not have unrestricted administrative port access from the internet. The instance appears to have been created 3 months ago for a proof-of-concept and may be orphaned.
ai_remediation_steps: Determine whether this sandbox instance is still in active use (check last login)
If unused: terminate the instance
If still needed: remove the public IP and restrict RDP to VPN CIDR only
Consider replacing RDP access with AWS Systems Manager Session Manager
